description.zh: 说明：根据座席工号查询指定座席的统计项名称支持按照多个座席工号进行查询，多个座席工号之间使用英文逗号","分隔，默认查询账户下所有座席的统计信息
description.en: The IDs of the agents to query. To specify multiple agents, separate their IDs with a comma (,). If you omit this parameter, statistics for all agents in the account are returned by default.

description.zh: 统计时间段；正整数，1～24，最大值是24时
description.en: The end hour of the query's time range. Valid values: 1–24.

description.zh: 统计项名称；取队列实时统计的统计字段名称，多个队列统计项之间使用英文逗号","分隔，默认查询所有统计项
description.en: The fields for real-time queue statistics. To specify multiple fields, separate them with a comma (,). If this parameter is omitted, all fields are returned by default.

description.zh: 说明：根据外呼组编号查询指定座席的统计项名称支持按照多个外呼组编号进行查询，多个座席工号之间使用英文逗号","分隔，默认查询账户下所有座席的统计信息
description.en: The IDs of the outbound groups to query. To specify multiple outbound groups, separate their IDs with a comma (,). If this parameter is omitted, statistics for all agents in the account are returned by default. This parameter applies only when IsUseGno is set to 1.

description.zh: 是否需要返回队列名称；0：不需要（默认） 1：需要
description.en: Specifies whether to include the queue name in the response. Valid values are 0 (no, default) and 1 (yes).

description.zh: 是否需要外呼组查询；说明：0 关闭外呼组查询，1 开启外呼组查询。默认为关闭状态
description.en: Specifies whether to query statistics by outbound group. Valid values are 0 (disabled, default) and 1 (enabled).

description.zh: 条数；正整数，默认值是10，最大值是500
description.en: The number of entries to return per page. The value must be between 1 and 500. The default is 10.

description.zh: 查询页码数的起始条数；正整数，默认值是0；与limit同步使用，例：offset=50,limit=10,表示查询第6页，每页10条数据，即总记录的第51-60条数据
description.en: The starting position for the query, used with Limit for pagination. For example, if you set Offset to 50 and Limit to 10, the API returns entries 51 through 60. The default is 0.

description.zh: 统计时间段；正整数，0～23，最大值是23时
description.en: The start hour of the query's time range. Valid values: 0–23.
